verdict.rationale: Evidence shows organization-level user management (owners/admins can invite users) and secure sharing of collections/environments among colleagues, but there is no detail on granular role types (viewer vs editor), permission scoping to specific APIs or collections, or a full RBAC model. Missing for 10: explicit role definitions (viewer/editor/admin), per-API or per-collection permission scoping, and documentation of how these roles enforce access control.
